### [Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering](https://www.anthropic.com/news/roadshow-launch)

**Anthropic** · 2026-11-10

Anthropic, PBC has launched its IPO roadshow to sell 825,000,000 shares of Class A common stock at an expected price between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.

- The offering comprises 801,351,354 shares sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 shares sold by existing stockholders, with an underwriter 30-day option for an additional 123,750,000 shares.
- Anthropic will not receive any financial proceeds from the shares sold by existing stockholders.
- Anthropic applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol ANT.
- Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC are managing the prospectus delivery for the offering.

**Why it matters:** The roadshow marks Anthropic's transition toward becoming a publicly traded entity on the Nasdaq under the symbol ANT.

### [llm-gemini 0.36](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Nov/10/llm-gemini/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-11-10

The llm-gemini 0.36 plugin provides access to Google's newly released Gemini 4 Carbon model, featuring variable thinking effort levels and integration with Google Antigravity IDE capabilities.

- Gemini 4 Carbon is currently priced at $2/million input and $10/million output, with prices scheduled to double to $4/$20 on December 1st.
- The model defaults to a medium thinking effort, but supports low, medium, and high thinking effort configurations.
- Demonstrated capabilities include generating standalone Three.js animations using OpenStreetMap data and coordinating multi-agent workflows using Google Antigravity's /swarm feature to build 3D browser games.

**Why it matters:** Developers gain public API access to Google's top-tier Gemini model and its agentic coding capabilities before a planned 100% price increase in December.
